bio.text: Nick Manganaro is the Republican nominee for Pennsylvania's 5th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 primary.

According to Ballotpedia, he graduated from the Episcopal Academy, earned a bachelor's degree from Reed College in 1979 and a graduate degree from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 1984, and worked as an investor.

In his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey responses, he describes himself as a former Republican precinct committeeman and retired finance professional who has lived in the district for over 25 years.
